newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Interport says rights offer valid.
newsitem.headline: Interport says rights offer valid.

text.p: Real estate developer Interport Resources Corp said on Tuesday it would still pursue its one-for-one stock rights offering despite a court order stopping the fund-raising activity.
Interport told the Philippine Stock Exchange it was not furnished with any copy of the petition by its minority shareholder, Andrew Bell and T & M Holdings Inc, seeking to stop the offering.
"Therefore, IRC could not possibly comply with the above resolution as it was not aware of the orders subject of the petition," corporate secretary Pelagio Ricalde said.
The Court of Appeals issued a temporary restraining order on July 10, a day before the deadline for the subscription.
Bell tried to stop the offering because he believed that the present Interport board did not represent the shareholders.
The proceeds of the rights issue are expected to fund real estate development and administrative expenses.
